description: A single, unambiguous contradiction with no distracting detail — a sanity-check demo.
scenes: SCENE 1 - EXT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT. Thunder cracks overhead as rain hammers the tin roof. Elena sprints from the barn to the porch, drenched, and slams the door behind her.
SCENE 2 - INT. FARMHOUSE KITCHEN - NIGHT. Elena, still dripping wet from the storm outside, tells her sister about the barn roof leaking.
SCENE 3 - EXT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK). The same storm night is shown again from a different angle: Elena walks calmly from the barn to the porch under a clear, starry sky, completely dry.

ground_truth.description: Scene 1 and Scene 3 depict the identical night (same storm, same walk from barn to porch) with directly opposing weather: torrential rain vs. a clear starry sky.
